Roth.indexSet_comp_subset✝.{u_1, u_2} {σ : Type u_1} [Fintype σ] {τ : Type u_2} [Fintype τ] (e : σ ≃ τ) (B : ℝ)
  (q r : τ → ℕ) : Roth.indexSet B (q ∘ ⇑e) (r ∘ ⇑e) ⊆ Roth.indexSet B q r

private theorem Roth.indexSet_comp_subset.{u_1, u_2} : ∀ {σ : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype σ] {τ : Type u_2}
  [inst_1 : Fintype τ] (e : σ ≃ τ) (B : ℝ) (q r : τ → ℕ), Roth.indexSet B (q ∘ ⇑e) (r ∘ ⇑e) ⊆ Roth.indexSet B q r :=
fun {σ} [Fintype σ] {τ} [Fintype τ] e B q r ⦃a⦄ a_1 ↦
  Exists.casesOn a_1 fun R h ↦
    And.casesOn h fun left right ↦
      And.casesOn left fun hR0 right_1 ↦
        And.casesOn right_1 fun hRd hRc ↦
          Exists.casesOn right fun h h_1 ↦
            And.casesOn h_1 fun hh right ↦
              right ▸
                Exists.intro ((rename ⇑e) R)
                  ⟨⟨Eq.mpr (id (congrArg Not (propext (rename_eq_zero_iff_of_injective R (Equiv.injective e))))) hR0,
                      ⟨fun j ↦
                        Exists.casesOn (Equiv.surjective e j) fun i h ↦
                          h ▸
                            Eq.mpr
                              (id
                                (congrFun'
                                  (congrArg LE.le
                                    ((fun x_0 x_1 x_2 i ↦
                                        (fun x_0 x_1 x_2 ↦ degreeOf_rename_of_injective (Equiv.injective e)) x_0 x_1 x_2
                                          i)
                                      ℤ Int.instCommSemiring R i))
                                  (r (e i))))
                              (hRd i),
                        fun d ↦
                        Exists.casesOn (Finsupp.mapDomain_surjective (Equiv.surjective e) d) fun d_1 h ↦
                          h ▸
                            Eq.mpr
                              (id
                                (congrFun'
                                  (congrArg LE.le
                                    (congrArg abs
                                      (congrArg Int.cast
                                        ((fun x_0 x_1 φ d ↦
                                            (fun x_0 x_1 ↦ coeff_rename_mapDomain (⇑e) (Equiv.injective e)) x_0 x_1 φ d)
                                          ℤ Int.instCommSemiring R d_1))))
                                  B))
                              (hRc d_1)⟩⟩,
                    Exists.intro (h ∘ ⇑e.symm)
                      ⟨fun j ↦
                        id
                          (Eq.mp
                            (congrArg (IsCoprime (h (e.symm j)))
                              (congrArg Nat.cast (congrArg q (Equiv.apply_symm_apply e j))))
                            (hh (e.symm j))),
                        of_eq_true
                          (Eq.trans
                            (congrFun'
                              (congrArg Eq
                                (Eq.trans
                                  (Eq.trans
                                    (congrFun'
                                      (congrFun' (congrArg Roth.index (map_rename (Int.castRingHom ℝ) (⇑e) R)) fun j ↦
                                        ↑(h (e.symm j)) / ↑(q j))
                                      r)
                                    ((fun P α r ↦ Roth.index_rename (Equiv.injective e) P α r)
                                      ((map (Int.castRingHom ℝ)) R) (fun j ↦ ↑(h (e.symm j)) / ↑(q j)) r))
                                  (congrFun'
                                    (congrArg (Roth.index ((map (Int.castRingHom ℝ)) R))
                                      (funext fun x ↦
                                        congrFun'
                                          (congrArg HDiv.hDiv
                                            (congrArg Int.cast (congrArg h (Equiv.symm_apply_apply e x))))
                                          ↑(q (e x))))
                                    fun x ↦ r (e x))))
                              (Roth.index ((map (Int.castRingHom ℝ)) R) (fun j ↦ ↑(h j) / ↑(q (e j))) fun x ↦ r (e x)))
                            (eq_self
                              (Roth.index ((map (Int.castRingHom ℝ)) R) (fun x ↦ ↑(h x) / ↑(q (e x))) fun x ↦
                                r (e x))))⟩⟩
